commands: echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-unset} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-unset} ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-unset}"; git status --porcelain; echo "---branch---"; git branch --show-current

SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo $SHA
python3 lib/test/pin-corpus-classifier.py --repo-root . --source lib --source scripts --source skills --source agents --source .github --adjudications lib/test/pin-corpus-adjudications.tsv --output /tmp/regen-inventory.tsv --revision "$SHA" 2>&1 | tail -40

SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
python3 lib/test/pin-corpus-classifier.py --repo-root . --source lib --source scripts --source skills --source agents --source .github --adjudications lib/test/pin-corpus-adjudications.tsv --output /tmp/regen-inventory.tsv --revision "${SHA}" > /tmp/pcl.log 2>&1
echo rc=$?
tail -60 /tmp/pcl.log

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; for f in scripts/render-grounding-block.sh scripts/config-get.sh scripts/discover-deferral-manifests.py scripts/issue-audit-state.py scripts/parse-acs.py; do ls -la "$f" 2>&1; done
grep -rn "config-get.sh" scripts/ lib/ 2>/dev/null | grep -i docs.labels | head -5
find . -iname "config-get.sh"

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
if rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled" 2>/dev/null &&
   git status --porcelain -z > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" &&
   [ -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   [ ! -L ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   git hash-object ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before"; then
  :
else
  echo "::warning::snapshot failed"
  rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" 2>/dev/null
  printf '%s\n' disabled > " …[per-command-truncated]

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; python3 lib/test/pin-corpus-classifier.py --repo-root . --adjudications lib/test/pin-corpus-adjudications.tsv --output /tmp/regen-inventory.tsv --revision e1f9d988d233ce6d6f29cbb200625a0e173e3f96 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "=== diff regen vs committed ==="; diff /tmp/regen-inventory.tsv .prflow/logs/pin-corpus-inventory.tsv && echo "IDENTICAL"
cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; diff /tmp/regen-inventory.tsv .prflow/logs/pin-corpus-inventory.tsv > /tmp/inv.diff 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; wc -l /tmp/inv.diff; head -30 /tmp/inv.diff | cut -c1-160

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
